setupBody: Your secure service is being configured. Please try again when setup is complete.
name: Your name
locationExplain: NearHire uses your location to show jobs and workers near you.
genericError: We couldn't complete that request. Check your connection and try again.
authError: Your session needs attention. Please sign in again.
phoneError: Enter a valid phone number, including country code.
otpError: Check the verification code and try again. If it expired, request a new code.
creditsError: You need a job credit to publish. Your draft is saved.
jobUnavailable: This job is no longer accepting applications.
duplicate: You have already applied for this job.
locationDenied: Location access was not allowed. You can search for a locality instead.
serviceUnavailable: This service has not been configured yet.
privacy: Exact addresses and phone numbers unlock only after acceptance.
title: Job title
postingNote: All posts expire 24 hours after publication. Do not put contact details or your exact address in the public description.
notificationPrivacy: Receive updates about your applications and jobs.
paymentUnavailable: Credit purchasing is not enabled in this build. Existing credits can be used to publish.
deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and associated marketplace history. Resolve active work first. Type DELETE to confirm.
limit: Too many requests. Please try again later.
validation: Please complete the required fields with valid values.
unknownUpdate: You have a new NearHire update.
application_received: A worker applied for your job.
job_expired: Your job post has expired. You can repost it.
noLocation: Choose a location to discover nearby work.
accountActive: Resolve accepted or ongoing work before deleting your account.
paymentVerifying: Payment submitted. Credits appear after server verification. Refresh your balance shortly.
phoneHint: Enter your Indian mobile number, or include + and the country code for another country.
otpIncorrect: The code is incorrect. Check the SMS and try again.
otpExpired: This code is invalid or expired. Try the latest SMS code or request a new one.
authRateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again. The service may require a longer wait.
authNetwork: No connection to the sign-in service. Reconnect and try again.
authProviderUnavailable: SMS sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
otpSent: Verification code sent. Enter the latest code from your SMS.
sessionRestoreError: Your saved session could not be loaded. Reconnect and try again; your saved login has not been cleared.
locationPermanent: Location permission is blocked. Open Settings or select a location manually.
gpsDisabled: Location services are off. Enable GPS or select your location manually.
gpsTimeout: Location is taking too long. Retry outdoors or select a location manually.
locationRateLimit: Too many location requests. Wait a moment before retrying.
locationUnavailable: Address search is unavailable. Use GPS or select a point on the map and confirm the locality.
mapNotConfigured: Map tiles are not configured. Use GPS or enter coordinates to continue.
mapFailed: The map could not load. Check your connection and retry.
movePin: Drag the pin or tap the map to select the work location.
locationLoading: Finding your location… You can use manual selection if GPS is slow.
noPlaces: No matching places. Try another locality or use GPS/manual coordinates.
manualCoordinates: Manual fallback: enter real coordinates, then confirm the locality. No sample location is selected automatically.
privateLocationNote: Exact coordinates and address are private. Other workers see only locality and an approximate point until acceptance. Do not put private address details in public title or description.
enableNearbyAlerts: Use this location for nearby job alerts
noCredits: No Job Credits remaining. You need 1 credit to publish a job.
creditEstimate: The final balance is confirmed when your job is published.
workFree: Finding and applying for work is free.
locationPinHint: Choose a point on the map and confirm the locality.
previewAction: Preview only. No changes were sent.
previewInfo: Development presentation data. No sign-in or backend writes. Maps load from the configured tile provider.
mapConfigurationMissing: Map configuration is missing. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL to a valid HTTPS style.
locationUnconfirmed: Confirm the locality for your selected point
distanceInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.
loadedMapResults: Showing loaded results. Use the list to load more jobs; the map displays up to 100 markers.
workspaceQuestion: What would you like to do?
workspaceFlexible: One account. Switch anytime from Profile.
postTypeQuestion: What type of work are you posting?
workerPrivacy: Only opted-in available workers appear. Locations and distances are approximate.
workerDiscoveryError: Worker discovery is unavailable. Please retry.
noWorkers: No available workers found in this area.
discoveryConsent: Off by default. Enable to share your name, skills and approximate location with nearby hirers while available. Exact GPS and phone stay private. Turn off anytime.
workspaceSaveError: Could not save workspace. Please retry.
currentLocationUnavailable: Current location is unavailable. Choose a location manually.
confirmApplyNote: Your work profile will be shared with the employer. Contact details stay private until acceptance.
noActivity: No items in this section yet. Browse nearby work or choose another status.
reviewRepost: Review this listing before reposting. The previous listing remains in your history.
noNotificationsHint: Work and application updates will appear here.
previewJobDescription: Help with daily tasks. Equipment and guidance are provided.
paymentFailed: Payment could not be confirmed. Retry verification or refresh your balance before paying again.
paymentCancelled: Checkout cancelled. Refresh your balance if a payment was submitted.
nativePaymentRequired: Checkout requires the Android development app. No payment has been started here.
creditExpiryRule: Monthly credits expire 30 days after grant and are used first. Welcome and purchased credits do not expire.
authOr: OR
googleFailed: Google sign-in could not be completed. Please try again or use your existing login method.
googleCancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
identityConflict: This sign-in method belongs to another account, or your session changed. Sign in to your original account. Accounts cannot be merged here.
linkingUnavailable: Account linking is not available yet. Please try again later.
identityAdvice: Already have a NearHire account? Sign in using your existing method, then link another method here to keep your wallet and history.
googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
